design.implementation: Reuse existing API-backed modules; no prototype fixture/markup promotion or second framework
design.navigation: Zero writes. Full episode drafts with original base version, dirty/revision/scene/slot selection; graph drafts keyed by workflow ID. Preserve inactive dirty drafts and beforeunload protection; explicit saves retain409 conflicts.

graph.mjs: topologicalOrder(nodes,edges): nodeId[] with stable lexical ID ties

resolvePrerequisite(nodes,edges,nodeId,type): traverse all incoming paths through intermediate roles, stop each path at its nearest node of requested type; exactly one boundary ID required,409 missing/ambiguous
candidates.mjs: candidateManifest(store,episode,workflow,options={}): full normalized scenes/source/rights/assets/hashes/trims and workflow/selection/disclosure/publication metadata
verifyCandidateAssets(store,manifest): async actual registered-local asset hash and rights verification

rules: 128 nodes /256 edges; keep1MiB body; unique IDs/edges/endpoints, self/cycle/connectivity checks; same-type edges can be acyclic
Exact NODE IDs only selectedStages/startStage; no type fallback; literal ID render valid
Topological execution and selected downstream reachability from explicit start

Transitive incoming-path boundary resolution, not direct parents or first matching type: stop each path at nearest requested producer. Required storyboard/script/render/review unique at that boundary; optional news/trend absent is valid; parallel candidates remain ambiguous. Repeated same-role chains bind the nearest producer, so render1-review1-render2-review2 binds review2 to render2. Render aggregates all relevant upstream generate outputs. Use the same resolver for structural prerequisite validation and runtime.
Per-review-node outputs and matching render; no first-role lookup anywhere; selected review aggregate determines run state
Persist original generation job intent before submission; reuse per node/scene after cancel/restart/resume and never reapply/resubmit blindly
Owned workflow only for selected project; no different episode/channel or first-channel fallback

methods: createWorkflowCopy({templateId,channelId,episodeId,expectedTemplateVersion}) -> fresh owned workflow v1; preserve node IDs within new workflow identity; only graph/name/config/lineage copied, no operational records
commitWorkflowReview(workflowId,runId,reviewNodeId,details) -> only that review node; run.reviews keyed by node ID; NO new run.review alias
store.schema: Add workflow_node_reviews(id PRIMARY KEY,run_id,review_node_id,data,UNIQUE(run_id,review_node_id)); leave old workflow_reviews rows/table untouched and read-only. Map historical single review only when exactly one legacy review node exists; no guessed ID fallback. New writes only new table.
rules: Validate/persist ownership+template lineage; immutable on project edits
Explicit template edits make new versions; old project copies never auto-update; divergent import UI is not part of this cutover
Publish config copied to another channel must rebind to destination, no stale channel override
Single shared constant for reference-bearing side tables and pruning; include new reviews/approvals/source evidence as applicable; never prune referenced media
Preserve old episode/workflow/history/review rows and optimistic concurrency; no destructive migration

engineAPI.quote: await WorkflowEngine.quote(workflowId,episodeId,{selectedStages,startStage,resumeRunId,expectedWorkflowVersion,expectedEpisodeVersion,disclosure}) -> persisted generation plan containing full candidate, fingerprint, per-node exact input/cost or explicit unquoted status, aggregate, expiry
engineAPI.start: WorkflowEngine.start(workflowId,episodeId,{existing version/selection/resume fields,allowGeneration,generationPlanId,generationFingerprint,acceptUnquotedEstimate,disclosure}); require valid whole-plan consent for selected generation and actual target scene IDs; verify current exact target before each paid call
engineAPI.review: await WorkflowEngine.review(workflowId,runId,body) requires body.reviewNodeId; keep existing /review URI with no legacy type-inference route
engineAPI.publication: WorkflowEngine constructor gains publication adapter; publish node uses exact connected review/render and preexisting explicit final publication approval, never manufactures approval or uses Studio automation

methods: search({query,kind,limit}) -> explicit status and Commons items
importMedia(body) -> re-fetch by Commons page ID, verify supported original/raster/video URL+metadata+human rights acknowledgement, bounded download/probe/hash/register; no arbitrary URL import
clearRights(uploadId,body) -> explicit owned/third-party/generated rights record (mediaRights entity), no automatic clearance
card(episodeId,{sceneId,expectedVersion}) -> preserve story/text/evidence/narration and convert to original text-only title card, no image/upload/license fabrication or provider call
rules: Validate scene and slot source/evidence roundtrip; third-party asset requires matching rights record and local hash; source-less original title card needs no upload
Original media hashes and source/license/attribution/trim records remain in versioned episode history; generated/illustrative visuals not factual footage
Required attributions are rendered legibly and carried into publication description/manifest
Use exact verified Commons schema/host policy in protocols.json, explicit configurable descriptive contact User-Agent on metadata AND downloads
403/429 retain blocked/rate-limited + Retry-After state, not no-results; never fallback silently on provider/config failure

publication.oauth: YouTubeOAuth({store,fetchImpl,clientId,clientSecret,redirectUri,testing,tokenKey?}); begin(channelId,{sessionId,correlationToken}) -> authUrl/internal cookie data; complete({state,code,error,correlationToken},{isSessionActive}) -> sanitized status; status(channelId), accessToken(channelId), disconnect(channelId)
oauthRules: Require local channel.externalId to be known UC ID BEFORE authorize; callback channels.list mine must match, never set or guess externalId from first result

One-time short-lived state+PKCE AND independent host-only HttpOnly Lax correlation cookie; preserve normal Strict cookie, verify initiating session still active; consume state including denial, clear cookie and clean redirect
Tokens/codes/verifiers/resumable URLs never entity/event/history/state/knowledge; encrypted private0600 runtime files only; sanitized scopes/expiry/channel/status to browser
Request/verify youtube.force-ssl, preserve refresh token when omitted, explicit expiry/reconsent and conditional Testing7-day bound
publication.service: PublicationService({store,oauth,fetchImpl}); approve(body,{ownerId}) -> final exact manifest approval; publish(approvalId,{ownerId}) -> persisted queued intent; resume(intentId,{ownerId}); state(approvalId); list(episodeId); close()
rules: Final approval binds owner/project/channel/actual output job/hash/scene rights and metadata/audience/disclosure; changes invalidate it

One approved click drives private resumable insert -> actual readback processing/identity/channel/metadata/status -> same remote ID public update -> public readback; persistent phase/session identity before each effect
No duplicate insert after failed/uncertain completion; reconcile saved resumable session/known video ID; unknown stays unknown
Unaudited API project private restriction is explicit provider_blocked/private_restricted state, never false published

Disable all automated YouTube platform-session attach/click/input/navigation APIs during cutover; keep manual external Studio link and other platform behavior. NO default flag to re-enable unsafe YouTube automation

http.dependencies: new optional mediaOptions/youtubeOptions/publicationOptions and fetch injection only for isolated fixtures; production defaults real adapters
rules: All API writes authenticated/admin/same-origin; only callback exception with full correlation protection
Do not expose private service internals in /api/state or logs
Keep existing local upload allowlists/probe+protocol protections and1MiB JSON limit; new import uses same protections

uiContract.canvas: Export bindProject({episodeId,channelId}), hasAnyChanges(), getContext() in existing createWorkflowEditor; load() remains read-only; bind preserves per-workflow drafts and explicit project association. No navigation copy/save; explicit Create project workflow button calls copies. getContext returns {episodeId,channelId,workflowId,workflowVersion,selectedNodeId,reviewNodeId,runId}.
uiContract.tools: createProductionTools({api,getEpisode,getWorkflowContext,refresh,onEpisodeUpdated,toast,canMutate}) -> {html({mode:source|delivery}),mount(),destroy()}; Main Studio owner imports/mounts it in existing production context, no second global state. Source/Delivery author owns only new production-tools.js.
uiContract.modes: Semantic A/B controls (data-action=view data-view=studio|workflow acceptable), selected context visible; existing task views remain same context; source/rights/review/delivery use actual service state, not fixtures; generated consent renders all selected node inputs/costs/disclosure and server plan fingerprint

required: Valid Tester RED before production implementation for each seam
InitialGraph+fullPipelineGraph preserve optional absent news behavior
Parallel render/review branches with second approval and branch2 start/resume
Two-project/two-channel copies and conflict-safe draft navigation
Commons UA,403/429,no arbitrary URL/uncleared thumbnail, source card/no paid-call and real credited raster/video render
Exact multi-generation plan invalidation/recovery and no double apply
OAuth strict/Lax binding, channel mismatch, token bytes absent state/export, private/public field and recovery fixtures
Current real app browser all requested stages at desktop/mobile, existing premiere+ops runners
Final syntax, scoped/new tests then required integration suite, actual FFmpeg render, immutable new harness semantic contract+verify

notes: No extra client draft wrapper module; use native Maps and existing history utilities
No destructive review migration, run.review alias, unique-type shorthand, optional-context required error, first-channel fallback or prototype promotion
Canonical existing PW contract remains SSOT; this is derived executable interface plan, not an A-grade Ouroboros seed claim
